title: Zimple Adventuring
description: Exploring without too much hassle. Perfect with friends!
body:
This modpack is designed around exploration, progression, and creative engineering. It expands world generation with Biomes O' Plenty, adding diverse landscapes and structures to explore.

Players can venture into The Aether, a fully featured new dimension with unique mobs and dungeons.

Powerful dragons provide a challange, that reward preparation and teamwork.

Automation and engineering are supported through Create, allowing players to build mechanical systems, automate resource processing, and experiment with large-scale machinery.

The pack is balanced for both solo play and multiplayer, making it suitable for cooperative survival with friends.

**OLDER VERSIONS CAN BE FOUND ON FORGE.**
